title: Met Gala: How Zac Posen Sold Kendall Jenner on Her Greek Goddess Gown (Exclusive)
summary: After years of enduring fashion-world snobbery, the wunderkind designer turned Gap creative director is back on top of the stairs. He told The Hollywood Reporter the backstory of both his classic Gap look, and his neoclassical creation for Jenner, inspired by the Louvre's most famous statue.
